preconditions.description: The length of the string s must be between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s)
preconditions.description: All characters in the string s must be small Latin letters.

postconditions.description: If a valid rearrangement exists, the output must be 'YES' followed by the rearranged string.
If no valid rearrangement exists, the output must be 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: any(s[p-1] == s[p*i-1] for i in range(1, len(s) // p + 1)) for p in primes if p <= len(s)
postconditions.description: For each prime p less than or equal to the length of s, the characters at positions p and p*i must be equal for all valid i.
